back.bm: Linear: graf garis lurus. Tak linear: lengkung

back.en: Through as many points as possible, rest balanced either side
back.bm: Melalui seberapa banyak titik, baki seimbang di kedua-dua belah

back.en: Rewrite as Y = mX + c (Y, X contain variables; m, c contain only constants)
back.bm: Tulis semula sebagai Y = mX + c (Y, X mengandungi pemboleh ubah; m, c hanya pemalar)

back.en: Divide by x: y/x = ax + b → plot y/x vs x
back.bm: Bahagi dengan x: y/x = ax + b → plot y/x lwn x

back.en: log y = (log b)x + log a → plot log y vs x
back.bm: log y = (log b)x + log a → plot log y lwn x

back.en: log y = n log x + log a → plot log y vs log x
back.bm: log y = n log x + log a → plot log y lwn log x

back.en: Plot y vs 1/x: gradient a, intercept b
back.bm: Plot y lwn 1/x: kecerunan a, pintasan b

back.en: Gradient from two far-apart points on the line; intercept where X = 0
back.bm: Kecerunan daripada dua titik berjauhan pada garis; pintasan di mana X = 0

back.en: If log a = c then a = 10ᶜ
back.bm: Jika log a = c maka a = 10ᶜ

back.en: Read Y from the line at the given X, then convert back to y
back.bm: Baca Y daripada garis pada X yang diberi, kemudian tukar semula kepada y
